shellCommands.command: find /workspace/node_modules/next -maxdepth 2 -name "*.d.ts" 2>/dev/null | xargs grep -l "viewTransition" 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---link.d.ts---"; cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/link.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80

grep -rn "experimental.viewTransition\|viewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/build/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---config types---"; find /workspace/node_modules/next -maxdepth 2 -name "*.d.ts" | xargs grep -l "viewTransition" 2>/dev/null | head

grep -rn "startViewTransition\|ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/router.js 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== app-router ==="; ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/ | head -40

grep -rn "startViewTransition\|addTransitionType\|ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/app-router.js 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== search all client for startViewTransition ==="; grep -rln "startViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/ 2>/dev/null

grep -rn "ViewTransition\b\|addTransitionType\|useViewTransition\|startViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== react index types ==="; find /workspace/node_modules/@types/react -name "*.d.ts" 2>/dev/null | xargs grep -l "ViewTransition" 2>/dev/null | head

find /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs -iname "*view-transition*" 2>/dev/null; echo "=== grep view transition in docs ==="; grep -rln "view-transition\|ViewTransition\|transitionTypes" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null | head -10

cat /workspace/node_modules/react/package.json | grep '"version"'; echo "=== @types/react version ==="; cat /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/package.json | grep '"version"'; echo "=== ViewTransition export in react index.d.ts ==="; grep -rn "ViewTransition\b" /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== canary re-export ==="; grep -n "canary\|experimental" /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

grep -rn "ViewTransition\b\|addTransitionType" /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head; echo "=== check canary.d.ts exports ViewTransition ==="; grep -n "export const ViewTransition\|export function addTransitionType" /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts

grep -n "canary\|ViewTransition\|reference path" /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head; echo "=== total lines ==="; wc -l /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts; echo "=== how next-env handles ==="; ls /workspace/next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null && cat /workspace/next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null
cd /workspace && timeout 180 npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30
cd /workspace && cat next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "=== tsconfig include now ==="; grep -A3 '"include"' tsconfig.json

grep -rln "ViewTransition\|viewTransition\|view-transition" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/ 2>/reactdomgrep.txt; head -5 /workspace/reactdomgrep.txt; echo "=== count ==="; wc -l /workspace/reactdomgrep.txt; rm -f /workspace/reactdomgrep.txt

grep -o "ViewTransitionOnHostInstances[^;]\{0,400\}" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.development.js | head -2; echo "=== how child host instance gets name ==="; grep -o "viewTransitionName[^;]\{0,300\}" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.development.js | head -4
cd /workspace && timeout 200 npm run build 2>&1 | tail -40

cd /workspace && (npm run start >/tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6 ; echo "=== HOME ===" ; curl -s http://localhost:3000/ -o /tmp/home.html -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" ; echo "=== PRODUCT ===" ; curl -s http://localhost:3000/product/classic-sneakers -o /tmp/product.html -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" ; echo "=== server log ===" ; cat /tmp/next-start.log | tail -8

cd /workspace && echo "=== HOME: product-card / view-transition markers ===" ; grep -o "product-card\|product-image\|nav-forward\|product-classic-sneakers\|view-transition" /tmp/home.html | sort | uniq -c ; echo "=== check morph name style in home ===" ; grep -o "view-transition-name:[^;\"]*" /tmp/home.html | sort | uniq -c | head ; echo "=== PRODUCT page markers ===" ; grep -o "product-hero\|back-link\|nav-back\|product-classic-sneakers\|skeleton-text\|product-info" /tmp/product.html | sort | uniq -c

cd /workspace && echo "=== product details streamed? ===" ; grep -o "Classic Sneakers\|Timeless design meets everyday comfort\|Wireless Headphones" /tmp/product.html | sort | uniq -c ; echo "=== home product names ===" ; grep -o "Classic Sneakers\|Leather Backpack\|Wireless Headphones\|Cotton Hoodie" /tmp/home.html | sort | uniq -c ; echo "=== CSS: view-transition rules emitted? ===" ; grep -rl "view-transition-old" /workspace/.next/static/css/ 2>/dev/null | head ; grep -ho "view-transition-old(.nav-forward)\|view-transition-group(.morph)\|prefers-reduced-motion" /workspace/.next/static/css/*.css 2>/dev/null | sort -u
cd /workspace && find .next -name "*.css" 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== search all css content for our rules ==="; grep -rl "nav-forward\|via-blur\|prefers-reduced-motion" .next 2>/dev/null | head

cd /workspace && grep -o "view-transition-old(.nav-back)\|view-transition-new(.nav-forward)\|view-transition-new(.nav-back)\|view-transition-old(.slide-up)\|via-blur\|keyframes slide\|keyframes slide-y\|keyframes fade" .next/static/chunks/362cpk6zrlz7w.css | sort -u
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; echo "server stopped"
cd /workspace && git status --short && echo "=== diff stat ===" && git diff --stat
